title: Greetings & Introductions
description: Learn how to greet people, introduce yourself, and handle basic social interactions in Spanish.

grammar.title: Ser (to be) - Name & Identity
grammar.content:
Use SER to introduce yourself. 'Yo soy...' means 'I am...' for names and identity.

Conjugation of SER:
- yo soy (I am)
- tú eres (you are, informal)
- él/ella es (he/she is)
- nosotros somos (we are)
- vosotros sois (you all, Spain)
- ellos son (they are)

grammar.title: Asking & Responding to How Someone Is
grammar.content:
To ask how someone is doing:
- ¿Cómo estás? (How are you? - informal)
- ¿Cómo está usted? (How are you? - formal)

Common responses:
- Estoy bien (I'm fine)
- Estoy mal (I'm bad)
- Más o menos (So-so)
- Perfecto (Perfect)

exercises.question: What does 'buenos días' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Buenos días' literally means 'good days' but is used for 'good morning'.

exercises.question: Complete: 'Yo ____ Sergiu.' (I am Sergiu.)
exercises.explanation: Use 'soy' (yo form of SER) to introduce yourself.

exercises.explanation: These are the basic greetings you'll use every day.
